title: CPU saturation and tail latency
description: One host per mark on CPU and latency axes. Shape and color identify CPU pressure or latency breaches using caller-supplied limits.

props.name: data
props.description: Unique host IDs and labels with cpuPercent from zero to 100 and nonnegative latencyMs. Incomplete or invalid observations are omitted and counted; duplicates reject the input.

props.name: cpuThresholdPercent
props.description: Finite CPU limit between zero and 100. Readings strictly above it are warnings unless latency also breaches its objective.

props.name: latencyObjectiveMs
props.description: Finite, nonnegative latency objective. Readings strictly above it are critical.

props.name: label
props.description: Console header label; the surrounding gallery or application owns its page title.

props.name: source
props.description: Caller-supplied source text in the footer.

props.name: window
props.description: Caller-supplied aggregation window or snapshot context in the footer.

props.name: updated
props.description: Caller-supplied freshness text; the component never invents live status.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plot content scrolls locally when constrained.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite entrance animation using scoped motion tokens and the current reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional Tailwind utilities for the outer frame.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of this chart instance.
